entries.0b74c7d5250171fe: The company is headquartered in Chuo-ku, Osaka, and consists of the company and 11 consolidated subsidiaries. Its main business activities are the manufacture and sale of lighting fixtures, rental of lighting fixtures and energy-saving equipment, and sale of furniture. Consolidated number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 1,648.
entries.2e0def3b276930c7: The company sells interior furniture and interior goods. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,160 million.
